subject: Startups
title: Board Seats and Governance
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Board Seats and Governance.

hook.text: When VCs invest, they often take a board seat. That seat gives them real power over the company's direction.

buildup.text: Board members approve budgets, hiring of executives, fundraising, and major strategic decisions.

discovery.text: A good board member mentors the CEO, opens doors, and provides honest feedback. They're a force multiplier.

twist.text: A bad board member micro-manages, pushes their own agenda, or forces premature exits to boost their fund's returns.

climax.text: Travis Kalanick was ousted from Uber partly by his own board. Board power can make or break a founder.

punchline.text: A board seat is a partnership. Choose your partners wisely.

quiz.question: What risk do founders face when VCs take board seats?
options: Board members may push agendas misaligned with founders
